cards.label: Principle
cards.title: Coherence
cards.front: Identity is more than a label.
cards.back: It is the maintained relationship among purpose, boundaries, permissions, memory, and action.

cards.label: Architecture
cards.title: Interface
cards.back: An explicit interface translates policy and purpose into bounded action on a substrate.

cards.label: Practice
cards.title: Capability
cards.back: A role should receive only the access it needs, with boundaries that can be inspected and reviewed.

cards.label: Architecture
cards.title: Composition
cards.back: Visible units, inputs, outputs, and transformations make emergent behavior easier to understand.

cards.label: Interpretation
cards.title: Myth and evidence
cards.back: Metaphor may illuminate values; evidence and explicit authority govern factual and operational claims.

cards.label: Practice
cards.title: Bounded exploration
cards.front: Safety can create freedom to learn.
cards.back: A bounded environment supports experimentation without silently inheriting unrestricted power.
